tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gter ston rdo rje gling pas gter ma lha mo bu rdzi mas mdos gzhung ngag 'don bzhugs so// lha mo bu rdzis mas brten mdos yin pas mdos che chung gang 'tshams gtor sgam sogs su rtag par bzhag nas slar logs bzhin gtang rags mdos kha gso rgyu bya dgos shing / bskang gso dang 'brel na bdag bskyed phur chung grol nas/ gtor bsngo bskang ba bcas rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bstod pa rdor glu bcas grub nas mdos gzhung la 'jug pa yin/ bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod pa shog zhes pa'i bar mdos gzhung ji bzhin la tshig rol chems brdungs/ gsum brdeg len bcas byas la bzhag ma bhyo sa mā ya bhyo zhes pa'i sngags 'di brgya stong la sogs pa bzla/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang bstan pa rin chen zhes pa 'di gsol kha yin pas/ gtor theb gsum du phye mar/ thebs kyu re dang sha dum bcas bshams shing / khrag chang gi sbyangs la gsol kha tshar gsum dgos pa'i mthar chems brdungs kyi dus mdos la 'bul dgos/ e ka dza ta'i las sbyor mthar chems brdungs nang la che'u 'di la zhes pa nas rakṣa rakṣa swāhā zhes pa'i sngags 'di 'don/ brtan bzhugs tshar gsum gyi mthar bkra shis gang shes zer ba 'di phun tshogs kun gyi gtsug brgya zer ba 'di 'don la yon bdag gang yin ming bsgyur gton/ de nas gtor 'bul nas dkyus ltar sogs byas nas mjug bsdu dkyus ltar lags/ rgya gar skad du/ yakṣa shrī he na ma/ bod skad du/ lha mo'i brten mdos/ srid pa chags byed lha mo dung skyong ma la na moḥ sri du bskyangs nas bso bar dang / lha mo la gnyer gtad pa ni/ ri rab steng du lha mo'i sku snum bag dang ldan pa spyi gtsug na dung gi thor cog yod pa sku la dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol ba sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ byis pa ma skyes na lag tu bum pa thogs pa byas/ byis pa skyes na spang na thog pa bya/

lha mo'i brten rdzas phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga/ mda' lnga/ 'phang lnga/ me long lnga/ rgyang bu lnga/ 'brang rgyas lnga/ gyi ba lnga/ sman le lnga/ dpal bshos lnga/ mdun la lha bshos/ rgyab tu bgegs gtor/ bya nag lnga/ lug nag lnga sogs/ dar nag gi gur phub/ 'dzan lcog zlum gtor bzang por gcig bya/ lug nag po/ bya mo nag mo gcig bcas brten du bzung / sang phod lam dus gtang rag bzong gcig khas blang bya/ gnyer gtad drag po bya'o/ /'dir ni yang gsang snying gi gnad yin pas shog dril na med do/ /oṃ swasatwi/ lha mo bu rdzi ma'i mdos gzhung nag 'gros sa skya'i phyag len ltar gyi ngag 'don go rim ni/ bdag bskyed phur chung mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i/ ki la ya yi dngos grub stsol bar/ mdos kyi khrod na yod pa'i gtor ma rnams la dmigs nas/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta nas/ 'og gi gtor ma dang 'dras pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur bar phur pa'i gtor ma ltar byin gyi rlabs zhing / mdos yo byad la dmigs nas/ oṃ swa bhā wā shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ mdos dang yo byad kyi 'bags pa dang mi gtsang ba la sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad stong par gyur/ oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥmu khe bhye sarba thad khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ mdos dang yo byad rnams rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba zag pa med pa ye shes gyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen po rgyun mi chad par gyur cig oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ mdos dang yo byad rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur pa thams cad mgron so so'i yid bzhin du thob pa la bgegs dang nyer 'tshe med par gyur/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā naṃ adya nutpan to ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mdos dang mgron so so'i gang la gang 'dod pa'i dngos po rnams/

yid bzhin du 'byung bar gyur cig oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te na ma sa manta spha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa mahā ma ni du ru du ru hri da ya dzwa la ya swāhā/ mdos mgron rnams drag zhan che chung med pa so so'i yid bzhin du tshim zhing rang dbang du longs spyod par gyur cig na ma sa manta buddha naṃ gra he shwa ri pra pañdza ti ma hā sa mā ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ mdos dang yo byad rnams bskal ba ji srid gnas kyi bar du zad pa med cing mgron rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan pa gyur cig ri rab kyi steng gi sku/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kunḍa li hūm̐ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭaḥkyi bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ri rab kyi steng du pad nyi zla gdan la lha mo'i sku 'dzum bag dang ldan pa spyi gtsug na dung gi thor lcogs yod pa/ sku la dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang / khye'u yid du 'ong ba bsnam pa/ dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i dpral ba oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ḥ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bu rdzi sman gyi rgyal mo oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ spyan 'dren de wi ko ṭa'i dbyangs rol 'ur phab la sgraṃ/ gyi/ gyi/ 'ur la/ gyi/ gyi/ gyi/ gyi/ ma bhyoḥsum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan lha yul nas/ /lha rnams 'dul mdzad lha mo re ma ti/ /lha min pham byed dmag dpon re ma ti/ /lha phrug gso byed lha mo mu rdzi ma/ /mdzes pa'i tshul ston lha mo dung skyong ma/ gyi gyi/ gyi / 'dir lha mo'i spyan 'dren tshig rol chem brdungs mi dgos/ 'dod dgu gter ba'i gnod sbyin re ma ti/ /las rnams byed pa'i dam can re ma ti/ /chos rnams bton pa'i 'phags ma re ma ti/ /sa brgyad gnon pa'i sems ma re ma ti/

/bcug pa dgra yi mtshon nas spyan 'dren no/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi mtshon nas༞ /phyag rgya brgya yis༞ /thal mo rda yis༞ /rnga gling sgra yis༞ /sngon gyi dam bcas bzhin du gshegs su gsol/ /tshig rol chem brdungs gsum brdeg len bcas bya/ sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sna tshogs chu skyes shlau ka gcig rgyun bzhin la yang dag dbyangs rol chems brdung gsum brdeg len bcas/ da lta snyigs ma lnga yis dus/ /shākya seṅge'i bstan pa la/ /skye bo dmangs la thug pa'i tshe/ /sri'u bso ba zhal bzhes pas/ /pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ ho yang dag ma'i dbyangs rol bya/ lha rnams rgyal ba byed pa yi/ /lha mo khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha phrug mang po bso mdzad pa'i/ /bu rdzi ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs sri'u gsol mdzad pa'i/ /chags byed ma la phyag mtshal lo/ /chem brdungs sgram a ti pu ho/ pra titstsha hoḥ lha mi'i btung ba ro bcud sogs rgyun bzhin mdos dkyil na yod pa'i gtor ma rnams lha mo'i 'bru sngags la/ a ka ro bdun gyis bsngos/ de wi sa pa ri wa ra a sogs mthar 'bru gsum sbyar la/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bu rdzi sman gyi rgyal mo bskang rdzas kyi mchod gtor rgya chen po bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pas 'gal rkyen phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa/ 'khor dang longs spyod snyan grags legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / mdor na bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas yid bzhin du 'grub cing / khyad par sbyin pa'i bdag po'i rigs brgyud dar zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/

lha mo'i dgos bskangs dbyangs mtshan thog gzhan yang ma rol mo dang bcas bdun/ mgon po sku yod kyi dbyangs/ ho phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /mi zad 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /spos dri mar me me tog dang / /zhal zas sil snyan la sogs pa/ /mi zad 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ chem brdung sbraṃ / oṃ badzra puṣpe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta hūm̐/ gu las/ bhyoḥmakha' spyod sku lus nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /tshangs pa'i sras mo dung gi thor gtsug can/ /sa brgyad mnan nas legs nyes btags yang 'dzin/ /ma khyod sku mdog dkar la 'tsher ba ni/ /nyon mongs dri ma'i skyon gyi ma gos pa/ /sku la pañtsa li ka gsol ba ni/ /lha phrug thams cad dbang du bsdus pa'i rtags/ /dbu la rin chen prog zhu gsol ba ni/ /rin chen bang mdzod lag na dbang mdzad rtags/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen la 'khyil ba ni/ /yum gyi mkha' la sprul pa 'gyer pa'i rtags/ /phyag g.yas bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis sri'u bso pa'i las/ /tshe yis dngos grub ma lus gter ba'i rtags/ /phyag g.yon rin chen bsnams pa ni/ /nor rdzas gter gyis char chen 'bebs pa'i rtags/ /mchan khung ne'u les rkyal ba bsnams pa ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi re 'dod bskang ba'i rtags/ /zhabs la dan gyi lcags sgrogs khrol ba ni/ /thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel ba'i rtags/ /snyan g.yas gser gyi seṅge 'phyo ba ni/ /sman mo thams cad zil gyi gnon pa'i rtags/ /g.yon na sbrul gyi gdengs ka 'phyo ba ni/ /zhe sdang ma spang dbyings su dag pa'i rtags/ /snyan cha gser gyi dril chu dgrol ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun la bsnyen bskur byed pa'i rtags/ /lte ba'i khung nas nyi zla char ba ni/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho thams cad skem pa'i rtags/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu zla ba 'char ba ni/ /dus gsum ma lus mun pa sel ba'i rtags/ /spyan rtsa dmar po phyogs bcur gzigs pa ni/

/srid gsum rnal 'byor bya ra byed pa'i rtags/ /nu ma g.yon pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi/ /lha phrug thams cad gso na mdzad pa'i rtags/ /da ltar rnal 'byor kun gyi sri'u gso/ /steng gi lha rnams khyed kyis 'dul/ /'og gi klu rnams khyed kyis 'dul/ /bar kyi lha srin sde brgyad khyed kyi 'dul/ /rnal 'byor chung sri thal ba'i rdul du rlog /bskang ngo dam rdzas mdos kyi bskang / /lha mo khyed kyi thugs dam bskang / /dengs 'dir bu rta gnyis po khyed la gdams/ /bdag gi bka' nyan ma bu ma bral zhing / /srog rta gnyis po dam can khyed la bcol/ /rta yi 'og tu bu 'di ma bsad gcig /lha srin sde brgyad lag nas tshe dpal srid 'phrog la/ /bu chung 'di la tshe dpal gzi brjid bskyed/ /'di la tshig rol/ smon lam 'debs pa ni/ hūm̐ mdzad dmar dbyangs rol/ rnal 'byor bdag gi lha mo khyod bsgrub pa'i/ /lha mo khyod kyi byin rlabs kyi/ /bgegs rnams thams cad med par mdzod/ bsdus la/ rta dang ba glang nor dang 'bru/ /mi nor zas dang gnyen bshes rnams/ /nad med bde zhing dar ba shog /mi nor zas dang gnyen bshes rnams/ /nad dang mu ge kun bral nas/ /'gro ba thams cad bde ba shog /lha mo khyed kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag cag 'khor du gtogs pa la/ /longs spyod rnam gnyis rdzogs pa shog /bdag kyang dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba la/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ldan pa shog /log par lta ba'i mi rnams ni/ /bdun brgyud rtsad nas gcod par shog / 'ur/ 'dir tshig gi rol mo chems brdung bya/ gsum brdeg len bcas byas la bzhag go ma bhyo sa ma ya bhyo ru lu ru lu bhyo/ ru lu ru lu nag mo sha ni rtsa pa ya lha mo ya ma du hrīṃ/ sa gā ru ma dzaḥdzaḥ ces dus rtag tu bzlas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang bstan pa rin po che la dgongs te khyed rnams kyi dges shing mos pa'i thabs kyi bzhes la rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la nad dang gnod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod/

tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par spel/ dbang phyug dang nus mthu bskyed/ snyan pa dang grags pa sgrub/ grags pa'i 'gro ba pho mo thams cad dbang du bsdus/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog cig gzhan yang bdag cag rnams kyi rgyag chod kyi ma dang / blo lhag gi pha mdzod cig rgyab kyi slog pa dang mdun gyi mkhar ba mdzod cig nyin gsum gyi bya ra dang / mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod cig yo na srongs/ 'gyel na slongs/ chad na mthud cig ral na tshems shig gtor na tshol la/ brjed na bskul cig mgo gang gi yar la stod cig dkyus gang gi mar la bsrung cig gzhan yang legs par brgya dang sprod la/ nyes pa stong dang bsnol cig bsam pa yid bzhin du sgrub pa la/ re ba rgya mtsho ltar bur skongs shig mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol la mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog cig gnod pa'i dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i brten mdos 'di la brtan par bzhugs te/ dgra dpung chom la bgegs dpung thams cad shigs/ dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung cig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs chen po bstod cig gzhan yang spro la dar 'phyor la/ khrom la dung bus cig gtam ngan rgyun chod la/ snyan grags 'jig rten du sgrogs shig dam pa'i chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkhar 'phyor la/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang byang chub bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig skyabs dang dpung gnyen dang rten dang gling mdzod cig bdag cag gi ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad myur du bsgrub shig shwa ring dbyangs rol/ bhyoḥchos dbyings shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma gcig lha mo bu rdzi ma/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i mnga' gsol bas/ 'dir rol mo/ /byin rlabs sprin phung thib se thibs/ / 'di nas rdung / yid dam rgya mtsho'i mnga' gsol na/ /grub gnyis gzim char thu lu lu/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi mnga' gsol bas/

/ye shes rgya mtsho khyi li li/ /dam pa'i chos la mnga'༞ /yid bzhin nor bu me re re/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun༞ /'phrin las gzi 'od sal la la/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i༞ /drag shul snang ba tshe re re/ /nor lha rnams kyi༞ /phyag g.yas bang mdzod khrig se khrig /gter bdag rnams kyi༞ /phun tshogs 'dod dgu nyi li li/ /gsang ba chen po'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /sha khrag gtor ma ri ltar spung / /dza gad bdud rtsi'i mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /dri bsung ngad pa sprin ltar 'thib/ /'dod dgu sna tshogs char ltar babs/ /ting 'dzin sngags kyi byin rlabs nas/ /snga bcol gtang rag 'di 'bul lo/ /da bcol zhu skyems 'di 'bul lo/ /bzhes shig rol cig dgongs par mdzod/ /mchod ni dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod/ /gsol ni spyan gzigs mchod pa'i gsol/ /rten ni brten mdos dag la rten/ /'bod ni dung chen gling bus 'bod/ /bskang ni mthun pa'i rdzas kyi bskangs/ /sbad do sde byed dgra la rbad/ /bskul lo drag po'i las la bskul/ /chos so dpa' bo'i dmag la chos/ /rten no bu rdzis rgyangs ma ring / /bskul lo bu rdzi phrag ma dog /g.yab bo bu rdzi spyan ma rtul/ /'bod do bu rdzi snyan ma sra/ /gsol lo bu rdzi thugs ma ring / /bstod do bu rdzi thugs ma chung / /bskul lo bu rdzi rtsal ma zhan/ /dam can bsrung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dam bcas zhal bzhes mdzad pa rnams/ /mthu dang ldan pa mnga' gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bu bzhin skyongs/ /rtsal dang ldan pa༞ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu dbu 'phang bstod/ /sha la sred pa༞ /dgra bo'i sha la hab se hab/ /khrag la rngams pa༞ /dgra bo'i khrag la hub se hub/ /srog la dbang ba༞ /dgra srog da ltar chod la shog /dmag dpon chen po༞ /sde brgyad dmag dpon dgra la drongs/ /bstan srung chen po༞ /bstan la gnod byed rdul du rlog /chos skyongs chen po༞ /chos 'khor dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /rig 'dzin bsrung ma༞

/gsang sngags mthu dang nus pa skyed/ /rnal 'byor dgra lha༞ /bcol ba'i las rnams myur du sgrub/ /zhi bas las la༞ /nad gdon bar gcod zhi ba mdzod/ /rgyas pa'i las la༞ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa spel/ /dbang gi las la༞ /khams gsum ma lus 'dul ba mdzod/ /drag po'i las la༞ /bstan la gnod cing sdang ba dang / /bla ma brnyas shing sems can 'tshe/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcu gyur pa yi/ /dgra bo dam nyams las ngan 'di/ /da lta bsgral ba'i dus la babs/ /drag po'i mtshon cha char ltar phobs/ /'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog /sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs su rol/ /don snying rnams lnga zhal du gsol/ /yan lag mgo chod rgyan du gyis/ /skyobs pa'i lha dang myur du phye/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' ma bcag /bla ma brgyud pa'i dam ma g.yel/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi ngag ma bcag /dus la babs so bsrung ma'i tshogs/ /khams gsum dgra bos srog dbugs la/ /dbang zhing rngam pa'i mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung / /bgegs la bskul ro rtsal ma zhan/ /bdag gis 'khor dang longs spyod dang / /dbang phyug ye shes rgyas par mdzod/ /phas kyi sbod stong bzlog pa dang / /nad kha rim kha dgra la bsgyur/ /rkyen kha mtshon kha dgra la bsgyur/ /mi kha god kha dgra la bsgyur/ /bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /drag po'i 'phrin las 'dus pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan bu rdzi lha mo yi/ /gang bcol 'phrin las myur du mdzod/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /ri rab rtse ltar mtho ba mdzod/ /rgya mtsho'i gting ltar rgyas par mdzod/ /nyi zla'i 'od ltar gsal bar mdzod/ /chu bos rgyun ltar ring bar mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /skye 'gro dar zhing bstan pa rgyas/ /mi nad mu ge mi 'byung zhing / /tshig rol gyi rjes su bdun brdung bsgyur/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa shog /lha mo'i gtso bo e ka dza ti'i las bcol ni/

hūm̐ḥ'aphrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyi grub/ /gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong / /sngags kyi bsrung ma mthu mo che/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba'i sku/ dpang gzu'i dbyangs/ /ral ba'i zur phud sa gzhi khyab/ /g.yas kyi phyag na zhing chen tsitta bsnams/ /g.yon gyi phyag na g.yu yi spyang mo bsnams/ /'jigs byed 'bar ba lcags kyu yi/ /mig gi dbang po sngon du phyung / /lcags kyi lding chen lding ba yi/ /dgra bgegs lus kyi khong khrol snying phyung shig /spyang mo sprul pa'i pho nya yi/ /dgra bgegs srog rtsa snying rtsa chod la shog /sha dang rus pa grol la shog /nang khrol dbang po khrol la shog /dgra bgegs la rngams dbang du bsdus/ /mngon spyod drag po'i rdul du rlog /dmar 'byin chen mo da tshur byon/ /srog gcod chen mo'i dus la babs/ /khye'u 'di la tshe stsol srog skyobs shig /tshig rol dgu brdung chems brdung gsum brdeg len bcas byas la bzhag tākka rakṣa kha bdun tra ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ rakmo ri ma rtsa rtsa kha la bhyoḥ ru lu ru lu ma ti bhyoḥ bu chung la rakṣaḥrakṣaḥswāhā/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa sogs tshar gsum byas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ sogs nas/ bye brag tu yang brten mdos 'di la dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug ma bu rdzi sman gyi rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa brten par bzhugs su gsol/ brten par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ zhes pa nas/ 'phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ gong bzhin la/ ye dharmā/ me tog gtor rol mo bcas tshar gsum byas la mthar bkra shis gang shes brjod/ de nas/ ye shes lnga ldan nas/ stsal du gsol/ oṃ shrī badzra ku ma ra kro dha rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ka wa tsi hūm̐ phaṭa/ dge ba 'di yi mtha' yas sems can kun/ /bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas/

/rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thams cad dbang gi gzugs kyi sku sprul pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi/ /skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis 'phral du bris pa'i dge 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ o rgyan bai ro/ gter ston rdo rje gling pa/ bkra shis 'byung gnas/ chos nyid rang grol/ bstan pa rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bsod nams/ 'khrul zhig pa/ 'jam dpal grags/ padma grags/ gzhung rgyan/ bstan rgyam/ 'brom ston/ gter chen bla ma/ gter gling pa/ de nas (bsod nams rin chen sa chen kun blo dang / /de sras dbang gi mtshan dang dkon mchog grags/ /kun dga' rab rgyas mnga' bdag byams bstan mtshan/ /lnga rigs kun bkras yab rje padma'i mtshan/ /mgu chen kun rin kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / /bzhed chen dbang sdud bzod pa phun tshogs dang / /kun dga' snying po mthu chen gsang ba'i bdag /drin chen rdo rje 'chang dbang sogs brgyud 'di yang kha'u'i brag rdzong gi gtso gdugs nyams gso zhus skabs sa chen kun blo'i 'jags sgrigs zhal gyi gdugs chog rag bsdus bla brgyud zhal skong du karma ratnas sbyar ba'o//) ༈ rim brgyud bdag la'o/ /swasti/ phun tshogs kun gyi gtsug rgyan rdo rje 'chang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bkra shis dam pa des/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen phreng / /chad med myur du 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /mdo rgyud man ngag rig gnas kun spel ba'i/ /'phags bod brgyud pa'i bla ma'i bkra shis des/ ༞༞ /byang phyogs thub pa'i rgyal tshab sa skya pa/ /yab sras rjes 'breng mkhas grub bkra shis shog ༞༞ /sangs rgyas rnams dang dam chos dge 'dun bcas/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog ༞༞ /chags spyod grub mtha' rigs bzhi rjes bzung ba'i/

/rgyud bzhi'i yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shog ༞༞ /yang phur dgyes rdor bde mchog gsang ba 'dus/ /tshe dpag med sogs lhag lha'i bkra shis shog ༞༞ /bstan pa bsrung zhing 'jig rten legs skyongs pa'i/ /bka' bstod dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog ༞༞ /gur zhal nor skyongs dkar bdud phur srung sogs/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan srung bkra shis shog ༞༞ /dmar mo skor gsum 'jam dbyug rnam sras sogs/ /sa skya'i rje btsun dbang lha'i bkra shis shog ༞༞ /rgyal ba sras bcas 'gro la rjes brtse dang / /spyi dang bye brag gdul bya'i gsol btab mthus/ ༞༞ /mkhas btsun bzang ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs kun/ /zhabs pad brtan cing bzhed dgongs mthar phyin nas/ /'gro ba kun la 'phral yun phan bde'i sgo/ /dge legs phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bdag gi dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba dang / /lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i bden stobs kyis/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen phreng / /srid mtha'i bar du rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/ //ces so// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 kun dga' blo gros/ gter ston rdo rje gling pa'i gter ma lha mo bu rdzi ma'i mdos gzhung ngag 'don/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
